prompt.text:
Implement a new immutable editor reducer. Export `EditorState`, `EditorAction`, and `reduceEditor(state, action)`. State contains `dialog` (`none`, `group`, or `pass`), a group-name draft, and a pass-title draft. `open` selects a dialog and clears only that dialog's draft. `edit` is allowed only for the currently open dialog and replaces its draft without trimming. `cancel` closes the current dialog and clears its draft. `save` trims the current draft, throws `TypeError` if no dialog is open or the trimmed draft is empty, then closes and clears the draft while appending the saved text to the corresponding array. Unknown dialog/action combinations throw `TypeError` without mutating input. Existing array order is preserved, and neither input arrays nor returned arrays may alias each other.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
